import importlib.util,json,time,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench',root/'scripts/bench-bindings/bench.py');bench=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(bench)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('runner',root/'scripts/bench-bindings/python/runner.py');runner=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
records={}
for name in ['sparkles','pyoxigraph']:
 eng=runner.Native({'engine':name,'data':str(root/'target/benchmark/data.nt')});eng.load();m=eng.m
 path=root/f'target/export-{name}.jsonl'
 with path.open('w') as out:
  out.write(json.dumps({'vars':['s','p','o']})+'\n');sink=runner.Sink(out,eng.encode,eng.touch)
  eng.query('SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE {?s ?p ?o}', ['s','p','o'],sink,time.monotonic()+30)
 fp=bench.fingerprint(path,False);assert fp['rows']==105300
 start=eng.size();triples=[(f'http://example.org/verify/{i}','http://example.org/verify/p',str(i)) for i in range(100)]
 eng.adds(triples);assert eng.size()==start+100
 assert eng.contains(m.NamedNode(triples[0][0]),m.NamedNode(triples[0][1]),m.Literal(triples[0][2]))
 bulk=[(f'http://example.org/verify-bulk/{i}','http://example.org/verify/p',str(i)) for i in range(100)]
 eng.adds_bulk(bulk);assert eng.size()==start+200
 for s,p,o in bulk:assert eng.contains(m.NamedNode(s),m.NamedNode(p),m.Literal(o))
 blank=m.BlankNode();p=m.NamedNode('http://example.org/identity/p');lit=m.Literal('identity');q=m.Quad(blank,p,lit,m.DefaultGraph());eng.store.add(q)
 stored=next(eng.quads(None,p)).subject
 # Newly supplied blank labels may be scoped on insertion. Reuse the stored identity.
 it=eng.quads(stored,p);first=next(it);assert first.subject==stored and first.object==lit
 newer=m.Quad(stored,p,m.Literal('later'),m.DefaultGraph());eng.store.add(newer)
 assert list(it)==[];assert len(list(eng.quads(stored,p)))==2
 records[name]={'full_export':fp,'write_added':200,'blank_identity':True,'iterator_snapshot':True}
 if name=='sparkles':eng.store.close();assert eng.store.closed
 else:eng.store=None
print(json.dumps(records,indent=2),flush=True)
